exact_script_edit.new: The device records electrical activity using sensors that rest directly against the scalp.
exact_script_edit.why: Adds a useful plain-language account of physical scalp contact. It clarifies measurement without implying thought reading, invasive sensing or clinical proof. Parent reports fresh primary-source factcheck and script-only cold-reader approval.

exact_direction_edits.style: Style: Warm, natural and conversational. Nora gives one interested listener an unhurried explanation. Take a real thought-breath after each completed sentence. Aim for about one hundred and ten words per minute including natural breaths. On the scalp-sensor sentence, complete electrical activity, breathe, then explain where the sensors rest. Keep phrase starts crisp and vowels ordinary. Carry the energy changes through intonation and warmth. Give public recordings confident respect, brighten at students helping design the extra page, and end with a welcoming question.

expected_effect: A same-rate estimate from the selected 110.2-second primary take gives 113.82 seconds at 220 words. Across the four measured primary takes it spans 108.35 to 113.82 seconds. This is a testable estimate, not a duration guarantee; fresh measured runtime and accuracy must pass.
voice_judgment: Keep Sulafat. It is the owner-picked current default. No alternate preset has evidence of a slower, equally suitable read here. Gemini 2.5 Pro with Sulafat is a documented same-identity model fallback, but this job already exhausted it and supplies no passing pacing evidence. The 2.5 Flash fallback at 75 seconds is evidence against treating a fallback as a pacing fix. Kokoro or another preset is not the efficient repair for this near miss.

safest_efficient_invocation.bounded_behavior: VO_TAKES=1 means one initial complete take and, only on a runtime miss, one automatic complete retry. Setting both fallback model names equal to the primary lets the existing deduplication use one model endpoint; it avoids another mixed-model six-take run. The existing four-attempt service retry still applies. No unsupported no-reroll switch is assumed.
